units.source_text: 大竹七段为什么不早下这一着呢？

en.t: Why did Otake 7-dan not play this move sooner?

units.source_text: 我作为观战者，也等得不耐烦，觉着有点奇怪，最后产生了疑窦。

en.t: As a spectator, I too grew impatient waiting, found it rather strange, and in the end began to have doubts.

units.source_text: 他分明是故意不下嘛，他是怄气还是耍花招呢？

en.t: He was plainly refusing to play on purpose; was he sulking, or was he trying some trick?

units.source_text: 这样胡乱猜疑也是有理由的。

en.t: There was a reason for such wild suspicion.

units.source_text: 就是说，这盘棋中途暂停休息了三个月，这期间难道大竹七段自己没有充分研究过吗？

en.t: That is to say, this game had been suspended midway for three months; during that time, could Otake 7-dan really not have studied it thoroughly himself?

units.source_text: 下到101之前，眼看着就要形成细棋。

en.t: Before move 101 was played, it was already clear that the game was about to become very close.

units.source_text: 虽然可以判断出收官还会有变化，却算不到终局吧。

en.t: Although one could tell that there would still be variations in the endgame, it was probably impossible to read all the way to the finish.

units.source_text: 排列几套下法，也确定不下来，也许是研究没有结果。

en.t: Even after laying out several possible lines of play, he may not have been able to decide; perhaps his study had produced no conclusion.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，这么重要的棋，休息期间七段也不会不研究吧。

en.t: Even so, with a game this important, surely the 7-dan would not have failed to study it during the recess.

units.source_text: 黑101经过了三个月的长久思考。

en.t: Black 101 had passed through three long months of thought.

units.source_text: 他佯装现在才思考了三个半小时，这是不是休息时间进行了研究的伪装呢？

en.t: Was his pretense of having only now spent three and a half hours thinking a disguise for the study he had done during the recess?

units.source_text: 不仅是我，连工作人员也怀疑七段思考时间过长，觉得厌恶。

en.t: It was not only I; even the staff suspected that the 7-dan was taking too long to think, and found it distasteful.

units.source_text: 七段离席的时候，连名人也嘟哝了一句：

en.t: When the 7-dan left his seat, even the Meijin muttered a word:
